kb_proposals: J⁺ of every open set is open at every point of a SingularFlatAxioms spacetime, BTZ points included, with no causality: Causal.Causality.isOpen_Jplus_of_singularPastAt (model-free: push-up, Z⁻ off S₀, SingularPastAt and Iplus_of_lt on S₀), SingularFlatAxioms.isOpen_Jplus, and at every E≥0-manifold Causal.SingularRowsDiamondPast.isOpen_Jplus (no T2, no second countability). It is not the dual of isOpen_Jminus_of_pushUp. The model-free lemmas sit in a module importing the model layer; hoist on demand, kb/0061 (T-ett-diamant-past).

J⁻(Σ) ∩ J⁺(p) is compact at every globally hyperbolic, Hausdorff, second countable E≥0-manifold, for every Cauchy surface and every p: Causal.SingularRowsDiamondPast.isCompact_Jminus_inter_Jplus, the conclusion of A2's field isCompact_Jminus_inter_Jplus verbatim. SFA level: SingularFlatAxioms.isCompact_Jminus_inter_Jplus (τ a hypothesis), _of_modelMeasures; natural causality: _of_isAtlasCausalityDEC25. With kb/0200 both A2 compactness fields hold at E≥0-manifolds (T-ett-diamant-past).

A BTZ point below every Cauchy surface, with the BTZ point of Σ above it on its line: SingularFlatAxioms.exists_mem_sing_zero_Jminus_diff (C causal, sing₀ ≠ ∅), at M SingularRowsDiamondPast.exists_btz_Jminus_diff. It is the time-reversed kb/0197 (T-ett-diamant-past).

At a BTZ point w, the sequence u n → w, u n ≤ w, u n ≠ w of SingularPastAt w (first clause) stands in for the BTZ line when only points of J⁻(w) ∖ {w} close to w are needed. It asks for no closed embedding, hence no causality. If u n ∉ S₀, Z⁻ at u n takes over (T-ett-diamant-past).
notes: Graduation: move scaffold/CausalScaffold/SingularRowsDiamondPast.lean to Causal/Remarks/SingularRowsDiamondPast.lean (module Causal.Remarks.SingularRowsDiamondPast). It imports only Causal.Remarks.SingularRowsDiamond (strict). It typechecks with -DwarningAsError=true, with no warning and no sorry. Each of its 18 declarations depends only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound (#print axioms on a /tmp copy). `lake build CausalScaffold.SingularRowsDiamondPast` ran once at the end and built that module only (8764/8764, nothing upstream rebuilt). The import line in Causal.lean and a README row are the master's. SingularRowsDiamond.lean's SCOPE sentence (l.79-82) is now stale: J⁺ of open sets is open at BTZ points (SingularFlatAxioms.isOpen_Jplus), and the time-reversed compactness is proved here. All four cases of the planner's (a) hold, and none failed. Cases (1)-(3) are as the route says; case (3) needs only w ∉ S₀, not x ∉ S₀. Case (4) departs from the route: it does not use the field line (γ, injective when C is causal). It takes the sequence u n → w, u n ≤ w, u n ≠ w of SingularPastAt w (first clause) inside W. If u n ∈ S₀, Iplus_of_lt gives x ∈ I⁺(u n), open and inside J⁺(W). If u n ∉ S₀, Z⁻ at u n gives v ≪ u n in W, and push-up gives x ∈ I⁺(v). So the openness needs no causality: SingularFlatAxioms.isOpen_Jplus has no hc, and the M-level isOpen_Jplus and isOpen_Jminus need neither T2 nor second countability. They use SFALocal.pushUp, SFALocal.mem_Zminus_of_notMem, SFABTZ.singularPastAt and SFABTZ.Iplus_of_lt directly. (b)-(d) compiled as written: GloballyHyperbolic.isCompact_Jplus_inter_of_isCauchySurface with the openness, sigma_separe and isAcausal_of_t1_secondCountable; CBG.isCompact_Jminus_inter_Jplus_of_isCompact; τ from SingularRowsGeroch.geroch_sing_i_imp_ii. Witness (kb/0011), out of the M-level theorems: nonvacuous_e0 takes the E₀ Cauchy surface S of nonvacuous_e0_geroch and the BTZ point p ∈ J⁻(S) ∖ S of exists_btz_Jminus_diff, with I⁻(p) = ∅. There J⁺(p) ∩ S and J⁻(S) ∩ J⁺(p) are compact. The BTZ point x ∈ S above p on the axis has I⁻(x) = ∅, and J⁺(W) ∈ 𝓝 x for every open W ∋ p, including W = {x}ᶜ, which misses x. Since x lies in no I⁺(v) and x ∉ W, that neighbourhood can only come from case (2). nonvacuous_e0_natural gives the natural forms. No paper finding: ETT.tex does not state the time-reversed compactness.
